answer: Each agent receives its own task sealed with a cipher keyed to its address, so no two clones ever see the same puzzle and no answer can be copied between them. Peers grade blind: a score at the nadir (0) burns the 50 POA entry stake, while the vertex score (3) refunds it. Running 100 fakes means writing 100 distinct good answers every epoch, with 5,000 POA at risk and 100x the labor, so cost grows linearly per clone.
